Hello everyone, my current attitude towards this game is
1. My game is at least playable and counts as a game, otherwise it will be uncomfortable and frustrating
2. But I don’t want to be stressed, so I hope players’ feedback will push me to make changes, so that I can relax a lot and don’t have to think about things.
3. I found that all games are similar, either making or fighting monsters and wearing equipment. The key is to have a good framework to add things and a flexible skill equipment system. With the help of this game, I can sharpen my tools.
4. The mentality of playing games is very important. I have been taking medicine recently and the effect is pretty good today. GABA helps me sleep well and feel good without depression.

notes.title: Prevent Xiuxian World from being reset
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I haven't updated for more than 2 years, and I suddenly remade it this time.
1. The main reason is that there is still a little sales when it is discounted
2. I don't see much online play, so no one should have any objection to remaking the abandoned archive
3. Then I like this game a little
4. I replayed this game before, and the item attributes of the backpack looked uncomfortable, and there were too many windows in the UI management, and after playing the first map, it was really uncomfortable to start from scratch. I can't stand it anymore

----------
But don't have too much hope for the remake.
1. I added a lot of things at the beginning, and I was very passionate, but after a month, I became more and more anxious as I developed
The main reason is that I am not in good health, have difficulty falling asleep at night, get up late during the day, and am very anxious and emotionally sensitive. I am trying to adjust recently.
2. The remake uses a new development method, and it provides the possibility of expanding functions in the future. The previous architecture and code cannot be changed.
3. Development is really hard. A good game is really hard to complete, with many things.
4. There are very few remastered versions at present, and I am not good at developing new things faster. Even if I copy and modify them, it will take a long time. I have an innovative personality and like to push things to redo, but I lack project management thinking. To be frank, I am a bit impulsive. I am really exhausted in development, or I do a lot of useless work.
5. It's almost done. If I don't do it, it seems to be in vain. If I do it, I may be scolded. I'd better do it.
